explanation.owner_view:
Great news! We recommend releasing your tranche payment as your project has successfully reached the verified slab stage (50% progress), with the verified value of completed work standing at ₹1,483,072.

So far, a cumulative amount of ₹1,214,337 has been disbursed out of your sanctioned loan amount of ₹2,500,000. However, we want to bring an important financial aspect to your attention: based on local benchmark data in Kukatpally, the total expected construction cost is estimated at ₹2,966,144.51, compared to your contractor's total quotation of ₹2,845,140. This leaves a sanction gap of ₹-466,144.51 against your loan and a cost-to-complete gap of ₹-197,409. This means remaining funds may not fully cover the remaining work, so we strongly encourage you to re-scope or plan for this shortfall early.

To help keep costs transparent, here are key questions to ask your contractor:
1. TMT Steel (Item 4.2): Which specific brand (e.g., Tata Tiscon, JSW, or Vizag Steel) will be supplied?
2. Anti-Termite Treatment (Item 2.5): Could you provide a detailed technical specification or price breakdown?
3. Teak Door Frame (Item 8.1): What wood grade is being used for the main door frame calculation?
4. Electrical (Items 9.2 & 9.3): Can you share an itemized cost breakdown for the Anchor Roma modular switches/sockets and the Havells single-phase distribution board?
5. Plumbing & Sanitary (Items 10.2–10.5): What are the specific model details and rate breakdowns for Supreme PVC drainage lines, Hindware EWC with concealed cistern, Cera wash basins, and the 1000L Sintex overhead tank?
6. Miscellaneous Work (Items 11.3, 12.1–12.4): Please clarify the paint brand for MS enamel work, model specs for the Nirali kitchen sink, fabrication weight for the main gate, scope of debris disposal, and temporary utility connections.
